messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]

- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-29, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-09, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-07-09 to 2025-09-29; recorded by handover/2025-07-09-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages. [valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- As of 2026-03-04, the webhooks service remains a Team Dune service. [valid 2026-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-04]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-06-12 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-12]

Question: Which service depends on the notifier?
